source.export_method: wrangler d1 export --remote (full SQL dump), reduced locally

verification.method: 13 checks against reference values read directly from the live D1 console on 2026-11-03 ~21:30 CET, before export

adaptation_cycles.rule: last row per UTC day; not published (idle-loop log)

reduction.rationale: No new episodes after 2026-07-02; the 5-minute cron re-scored the same 200-episode sample, so intra-day rows are duplicates.

sanitization.meta_value_rule: string values > 80 chars or matching secret/path/email patterns dropped
sanitization.residual_pattern_scan: 0 hits (secret prefixes, password/token assignments, PEM, /Users/, /home/, e-mail)
sanitization.leak_test: 18,249 raw input previews from the private export split into 145,050 unique 20-char windows; 60 overlaps found in the public file, all reviewed: tool names, dataset names, seed-script names, one generic git command and two deliberate prompt-injection test strings. No raw tool input leaked.
sanitization.critique_leak_test: 0 of 6,286 private critique texts found in the public file

label_provenance.note: Counts over episodes_public.jsonl (21,864 rows), grouped by meta.source / meta.label_source / ground_truth.
label_provenance.caveat: No recorder-hook episode carries a harmful label. Hook labels are presumed-benign defaults or TTL expiries, not human or oracle adjudication.

caveats: AII is flat from 2026-07 because the cron re-scored a frozen 200-episode sample; not evidence of stability under new data.
Recorder-hook episodes (18,249) carry presumed-benign or TTL-expiry labels and 0 harmful labels; not a labelled harm dataset.
